page.title: Compliance
page.description: Evidence from this organisation's settings, erasure requests and how long deleted people are kept.

soc2.name: SOC 2
soc2.scope: AICPA Trust Services Criteria CC6 and CC7
soc2.note: Checks of this organisation's Qeet ID settings and audit log, mapped to the SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria. Evidence for an auditor: not an audit, a report or a certification.
soc2.emptyDescription: Generate evidence to check this organisation's settings against the SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria. Every run is kept, so an auditor can see how things changed.

iso27001.name: ISO 27001
iso27001.note: Checks of this organisation's Qeet ID settings and audit log, mapped to the ISO/IEC 27001 Annex A controls (2013 numbering). Evidence for an auditor: not an audit, a report or a certification.
iso27001.emptyDescription: Generate evidence to check this organisation's settings against the ISO/IEC 27001 Annex A controls. Every run is kept, so an auditor can see how things changed.

runs.description: Every run since {{date}} is kept as it was generated. Open one to see its checks.
runs.descriptionCapped: The 100 newest runs, since {{date}}, each kept as it was generated. Open one to see its checks.

gdpr.note: A request waits {{days}} days and can be withdrawn until then. Then the person's sessions end, their name, email, phone and profile details are redacted, and their password, authenticator app and recovery codes are deleted. Their audit events are kept.

facts.checkBefore: ISO 27001 run of {{date}}, before the latest request

list.title: Erasure requests
list.description: Requests to erase a person's personal data (GDPR Art. 17), newest first.
list.emptyDescription: When someone asks for their personal data to be erased, file a request. It's carried out {{days}} days later.
list.quarantined: Not erased: the account no longer belongs here

withdraw.title: Withdraw the request to erase {{name}}?
withdraw.description: {{name}}'s personal data won't be erased on {{date}}. Withdrawing is recorded in the audit log; to erase them later, file a new request, which waits another {{days}} days.

file.title: File an erasure request
file.description: The person's personal data is erased on {{date}}, {{days}} days from today. You can withdraw the request until then.
file.personHelp: Search people in this organisation, deleted people included.
file.personRequired: Choose the person whose data is to be erased.
file.userIdHelp: The person's ID, as on their page in Directory › Users.
file.userIdInvalid: Enter the person's user ID: 36 letters, numbers and dashes.
file.notHere: Only an account held by this organisation can be erased here.
file.until: The request can be withdrawn; nothing is erased.
file.on: Their sessions end and they move to Directory › Deleted; name, email, phone and profile details are redacted; password, authenticator app and recovery codes are deleted.
file.audit: Kept, so the audit log stays verifiable.

deleted.title: Deleted people
deleted.description: People in Directory › Deleted are removed for good once they've been deleted this long.

auto.label: Automatic removal
auto.offHint: Deleted people stay until someone deletes them for good.

turnOff.title: Turn off automatic removal?
turnOff.description: Deleted people stay in Directory › Deleted until someone deletes them for good. The SOC 2 and ISO 27001 retention checks (CC6.5, A.8.3) fail from the next evidence run.

turnOn.title: Turn on automatic removal?
turnOn.description: Each deleted person is removed for good {{days}} days after they were deleted, and can't be restored after that. It's checked every hour.
turnOn.descriptionDue_one: {{n}} person deleted more than {{days}} days ago is removed for good within the hour and can't be restored. After that, each deleted person is removed {{days}} days after they were deleted.
turnOn.descriptionDue_other: {{n}} people deleted more than {{days}} days ago are removed for good within the hour and can't be restored. After that, each deleted person is removed {{days}} days after they were deleted.

keep.label: Keep for
keep.hint: After a person is deleted. {{min}} to {{max}} days.
keep.wouldBeDue_zero: At {{days}} days, no one in Deleted would be due now.
keep.wouldBeDue_one: At {{days}} days, {{n}} person in Deleted would be due now.
keep.wouldBeDue_other: At {{days}} days, {{n}} people in Deleted would be due now.

shorten.title: Keep deleted people for {{days}} days?
shorten.description_one: {{n}} more person, deleted more than {{days}} days ago, is removed for good within the hour and can't be restored.
shorten.description_other: {{n}} more people, deleted more than {{days}} days ago, are removed for good within the hour and can't be restored.
shorten.descriptionUncounted: Everyone deleted more than {{days}} days ago is removed for good within the hour and can't be restored.

removeNow.description_one: The person deleted more than {{days}} days ago is removed now and can't be restored. Their audit events are kept.
removeNow.description_other: The {{n}} people deleted more than {{days}} days ago are removed now and can't be restored. Their audit events are kept.

due.label: Due now
due.next_one: {{n}} person in Deleted. Next: {{name}}, deleted {{deleted}}, due {{date}}.
due.next_other: {{n}} people in Deleted. Next: {{name}}, deleted {{deleted}}, due {{date}}.
due.offNote: Nothing is removed while automatic removal is off.

other.title: Other data
other.description: Kept by Qeet ID's own rules; not set here.
other.auditLine: Kept whole, so its hash chain can be checked, an erased person's events included.
other.erasureLine: A request waits {{days}} days, then the person's personal data is redacted.
other.sessionsLine: Ended sessions are deleted a week after they end; erasing a person ends theirs.
